title: 2018 AMC 10B Problem 8
statement:
Sara makes a staircase out of toothpicks as shown:

This is a \(3\)-step staircase and uses \(18\) toothpicks. How many steps would be in a staircase that used \(180\) toothpicks?

solutions.text: In an \(n\)-step staircase the vertical toothpicks number \((1 + 2 + \cdots + n) + n\) \(= \tfrac{n(n+1)}{2} + n,\) and there are just as many horizontal ones. That’s a total of \(n(n+1) + 2n = n(n+3).\) Check: \(n = 3\) gives \(18,\) as it should. Now solve \(n(n+3) = 180.\) This factors as \((n-12)(n+15) = 0,\) so \(n = 12.\) Therefore, the answer is C.
hints: Count the toothpicks in an \(n\)-step staircase; the vertical ones number \((1 + 2 + \cdots + n) + n\)
With equal horizontal and vertical counts the total is \(n(n+3);\) solve \(n(n+3) = 180\)
